## What's new

Threadnote 5.2.0 brings connected work into private recall, makes memory and graph work easier to review, and adds a guided Codex Cloud setup for durable project context.

### Connect the work you already use

- Connect selected GitHub repositories, Linear teams and projects, Pocket recordings, and Superhuman Docs to read-only recall with clear source links and access boundaries.
- Manager gathers available integrations and active connections in one place, where you can inspect sync progress, pause access, or disconnect.
- Recall searches eligible local snapshots while refresh runs in the background. Use Manager's **Sync now** or `threadnote source sync <id> --apply` when you need an explicit sync result.

### Keep memories grounded and easier to manage

- Derived memories retain their reviewed, sanitized source evidence and report whether the current source has changed, disappeared, or remains unknown.
- Review memory consolidation drafts with their supporting fragments, citations, and relations before saving.
- Context Health presents scoped conflicts and evidence for review without choosing a winner automatically, and Manager makes project scope, active operations, and graph-snapshot age visible.

### Use Threadnote in Codex Cloud

- Codex Cloud setup restores managed guidance, refreshes private Git memory, prepares structural graphs, and verifies readiness in fresh tasks.
- Scoped Context Briefs combine relevant memory and graph evidence. A five-field Knowledge Delta stays reviewable before durable sharing.
- Local installations now create only `threadnote` and `threadnote-mcp-server` by default; organization credential helpers follow configured features, and doctor, repair, and update keep the same requirements.

### Reliable indexing and integrations

- Context Brief citation validation overlaps independent repository and worktree observations for faster large-repository checks without weakening validation.
- Integration imports preserve complete source pages and recordings, safely reuse available saved credentials, and keep synchronization-only resources out of the Manager tree.
- Updated runtime, parser, inference, and AI integration dependencies improve compatibility and resolve reported dependency audit findings while preserving local indexing, MCP negotiation, and telemetry privacy controls.

[Full changelog since 5.1.1](https://github.com/threadnote/threadnote/compare/v5.1.1...v5.2.0)
